'''Mochot Steep''' was a popular [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] trading site on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

[[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] eventually [[Attack on Mochot Steep|took over]], and the Mochot Steep remained under their control for many years. It was not until later that a large gang of troublemakers attempted to wrest control of the Steep back from the Tuskens, resulting in a turf war that lasted for quite some time and had a negative impact on the surrounding cities.<ref name="SWG:SS">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Steep Struggle}}</ref>
